messages:
Nina (PM): Quick thread to finalize dedicated-reserve SKU shapes and the default fallback + autoscale policy for GA. Call out showstoppers.
Jon (Eng): My priority is predictable latency for Performance tier. Propose default fallback: primary -> quantized-INT8 -> distilled-1/2 size. Make fallback order configurable per customer.
Sofia (Infra): Cross-az standby adds complexity. Recommend we only enable regional standby for Enterprise SKU and keep Performance as single-region with light prewarm.
Marcus (SRE): Eviction semantics: define for each SKU whether eviction is soft (drain) or immediate preempt. Soft needs a 10-15m drain window and drain metrics on dashboards.
Asha (CS): Sales feedback: Customers want a clear burst billing model and a way to opt into 'burst-insurance' for predictable behavior during traffic spikes.
Leah (Finance): Suggest metering burst in fixed windows (e.g., 5m buckets) to simplify invoices. Need utilization scenarios (10/50/90% bands) to finalize margins.
Nina (PM): Draft SKUs (high level):
- Starter-Reserve: 50 rps commit, no warm, pay-per-minute prewarm add-on.
- Performance-Reserve: 300 rps commit, light prewarm (weights pinned), 10m soft burst included.
- Enterprise-Reserve: 1.5k rps commit, full warm + regional standby, SLA-backed latency.
Jon (Eng): Implementation note: light prewarm (pin weights, lazy runtime init) is ~2 sprints. Full warm requires runtime process warm-up + cross-region sync ~4 sprints.
Sofia (Infra): I'll open INFRA ticket for prewarm plumbing and cross-region standby. tracker-bot: created INFRA-2791 assigned to @Sofia.
Marcus (SRE): Autoscale defaults proposal:
- scale_up: pending queue > 50ms for 45s OR CPU > 70% for 30s
- scale_down: node removal after 12m idle and CPU < 25%
- burst_mode: allow up to 2x baseline for 10m, then step-down over 5m by priority routing
Asha (CS): For pilots, we need SOW language that spells out eviction order and billing for burst. I'll draft and share with legal.
Leah (Finance): Provide expected utilization bands by Monday and I'll run pricing sims.
Nina (PM): Action items: Jon -> RFC for fallback & cache-sharing, Sofia -> infra epic (INFRA-2791), Asha -> pilot SOWs, Marcus -> oncall runbook + dashboard spec, Leah -> pricing sims. Target: RFC by next Wed, then lock SKUs.
Jon (Eng): Will do RFC. Also raising question: allow cache sharing across tenants in same pool? Security and QoS tradeoffs. We'll propose opt-in cache affinity.
Nina (PM): Good call. Queue that in RFC. Thanks all, post short updates here as tasks land. :thumbsup:
